name: contractbook
description: Search, read and draft Contractbook documents from Claude.
long_description: Connects Claude to your Contractbook account. Claude can list and search documents, read their full text, browse templates and create draft documents from a template. It never sends a draft for signature.

api_key.title: Contractbook API key
api_key.description: Your Contractbook API key. Claude Desktop keeps it in your operating system's keychain.
